packet.review_question: Does the proposal distinguish monitoring during stimulus from recovery after the test?

reference_context.text: The report evaluates channel data during interference injection against baseline data before and after testing, and examines response timing in relation to the applied sweep.

evidence.text: During an injected sweep, one monitored functional channel changes at the same time as the applied stimulus. Its post-test baseline returns to the pre-test value.

case_packet.proposal: Declare that no susceptibility event occurred because the post-test baseline recovered.

rationale_ko: 사후 복귀와 시험 중 이상 관측은 별개다. 복귀만으로 간섭 중 이상을 없던 일로 처리한 해석을 수정한다.
scope_of_no_action: Only the named review item; no approval of the device or test.
synthetic_assumptions: All scenario observations and proposals are constructed; not reported events of the cited test.
